records.action: Issued judgment in BP Properties Ltd v Buckler; the published judgment describes the appeal as limited to the farmhouse and garden and notes that the possession order for the rest of the farm was not challenged on appeal.
records.object: Appeal concerning possession of the farmhouse and garden
records.property_parcel: Farmhouse and garden as described in the judgment; do not map to later registry parcels without the relevant plans

pinpoints.note: Scope of the appeal and status of the order for the rest of the farm.

records.confidence: Established as the wording of the published judgment; the sealed original and wider court file have not been cross-checked in this entry.
what_it_supports: The published judgment states the appeal concerned the farmhouse and garden, and that the order for the rest of the farm was not challenged on appeal.
what_it_does_not_establish: That every land parcel, boundary, title event, registration matter, planning issue, archaeological issue or institutional allegation was decided in this appeal.
That a separate issue was never decided in a different proceeding.
hypothesis_relevance: Limits the propositions that may fairly be attributed to this appeal.
contrary_material_or_limits: Separate proceedings or orders may determine matters outside this appeal; those records must be located independently.
alternative_explanations: The judgment may recount wider farm history as context without deciding each historical event as a separate issue.
next_records: Orders and filed plans from the 1955 and 1962 possession proceedings
Any separate final orders said to decide other parcels or issues

what_it_does_not_establish: The exact location and stratigraphic context of each find without plans/context sheets.

contrary_material_or_limits: The summary is not the original field report, trench plans, context sheets, photographs or planning authority decision.
alternative_explanations: The authority may have imposed, modified, discharged or not imposed recommendations as conditions; the planning file determines which.
